title: SageMaker Setup for Regression and Classification [Hands-On]

cues.en: Hello, my friends, and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial on the SageMaker setup for regression and classification.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到迴歸與分類的 SageMaker 設定實作。

cues.en: Indeed, in the next tutorials, we will build a regression model and a classification model, and so we will set up everything now in SageMaker and therefore create a new SageMaker domain.
cues.zh: 接下來會建立迴歸與分類模型，先完成 SageMaker 設定，建立新網域。

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: In the search bar, let's enter SageMaker, and we're gonna take, remember the second one, Amazon SageMaker AI, which contains, you know,
cues.zh: 搜尋 SageMaker，記得選第二個 Amazon SageMaker AI，裡面包含

cues.en: the applications which will allow us to build the regression and classification models, meaning Canvas, right?
cues.zh: 能建立迴歸、分類模型的應用程式，也就是 Canvas。

cues.en: But before creating the application, of course we have to create the domain, which I remind, incur some charges, so make sure to do the cleanup tutorial at the end of this section.
cues.zh: 建立應用程式前，要先建網域，提醒會產生費用，務必做本節最後清理教學。

cues.en: And now to create the domain, let's click set up for a single user.
cues.zh: 按 Set up for single user 建立。

cues.en: And here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Our SageMaker domain is ready.
cues.zh: SageMaker 網域準備好。

cues.en: And so now if we go to user profile, you will see your user profile that was created automatically, and from your user profile you can launch the Canvas app.
cues.zh: 到 User profiles，會看到自動建立的設定檔，從那裡啟動 Canvas。

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Welcome back to Amazon's SageMaker Canvas.
cues.zh: 歡迎回到 Amazon SageMaker Canvas。

cues.en: In the previous section, we mostly did Data Wrangler, which is the feature of Canvas you're gonna use for data pre-processing, data preparation.
cues.zh: 上一節主要做 Data Wrangler，用於資料前處理與準備。

cues.en: But now in this new section on model development, while of course we are gonna build models, which is this picture here, my models, but before, and that's still part of this setup,
cues.zh: 這節模型開發，當然會用 My models 建模，但之前，作為設定的一部分，

cues.en: we're gonna import the data sets that we're gonna use to build our regression and classification model.
cues.zh: 先匯入迴歸與分類模型的資料集。

cues.en: So these are just simple data sets as we saw before, but we're gonna work with real-world data sets that are prepared, and so we're gonna go here to import those data sets.
cues.zh: 這些只是範例資料，這次用我準備好的真實資料集，所以到這裡匯入。

cues.en: You click the import data button, and then because these two data sets are CSV files, we're gonna choose here tabular.
cues.zh: 按 Import data，因為兩個都是 CSV，選 Tabular。

cues.en: Tabular, I'm gonna import two data sets, one for regression, one for classification, and we're gonna start here with the regression data set.
cues.zh: 會匯入兩份，一份迴歸、一份分類，先從迴歸。

cues.en: Alright, regression data set, we click create and there we go.
cues.zh: 命名 Regression dataset，按 Create。

cues.en: To import the data set, you can either select a file from your computer or remember, also import it from S3 or many other AWS services.
cues.zh: 可從電腦選檔，也可從 S3 或其他 AWS 服務匯入。

cues.en: But let's do the local upload.
cues.zh: 這裡用本機上傳。

cues.en: You'll see the two data sets ready in your model development folder.
cues.zh: 兩份都在 Model Development 資料夾。

cues.en: Let's click here, select files from your computer.
cues.zh: 按 Select files from your computer。

cues.en: Perfect. This took us to the AWS (indistinct) folder.
cues.zh: 很好，來到 AWS 課程資源資料夾。

cues.en: But now we're gonna go into the machinery model development folder in which you can find indeed the two data sets, the one for regression and the other one for classification.
cues.zh: 這次進 Machine Learning Model Development，確實有兩份，一份迴歸、一份分類。

cues.en: And since we're starting with regression, we're gonna import this one, regression_data.csv.
cues.zh: 先迴歸，所以選 regression_data.csv。

cues.en: So let's click open and we're gonna get a preview now of the data set.
cues.zh: 按 Open，接著預覽資料。

cues.en: Data set will import. Perfect.
cues.zh: 資料已匯入，很好。

cues.en: And now let's click here preview data set to have a look at our data set so that I can explain what this data set is about.
cues.zh: 按 Preview dataset，我來說明內容。

cues.en: So because we already covered data preparation in the previous section, this data set is already fully pre-processed.
cues.zh: 上一節已講前處理，所以這份資料已完整前處理。

cues.en: No need to do any data pre-processing.
cues.zh: 不需要再做。

cues.en: And it's a data set where each row corresponds to a cycle power plant and where the columns are different measures such as AT, which is the ambient temperature,
cues.zh: 每列對應複循環發電廠，欄位是不同測量，例如 AT 為環境溫度，

cues.en: V, the exos vacuum, AP, ambient pressure, RH, relative humidity, and PE, the net howley electrical energy output.
cues.zh: V 為排氣真空度、AP 環境壓力、RH 相對濕度、PE 每小時淨發電量。

cues.en: And the goal here is to build a regression model which will understand the correlations between the features here, which are the independent variables AT, V, AP, and RH,
cues.zh: 目標是建立迴歸模型，學習自變數特徵 AT、V、AP、RH，

cues.en: and the dependent variable, meaning the variable that we wanna predict, which is PE.
cues.zh: 與想預測的依變數 PE 之間的關係。

cues.en: And why is that a regression problem?
cues.zh: 為什麼是迴歸問題？

cues.en: It's because the variable PE here has continuous numeric values as opposed to classes, okay?
cues.zh: 因為 PE 是連續數值，不是類別。

cues.en: Therefore, we must build a regression model, and this is exactly what we'll do in the next tutorial, okay?
cues.zh: 所以建立迴歸模型，下一堂就做。

cues.en: So let's create the data set by clicking create data set here and the data set is created. Perfect.
cues.zh: 按 Create dataset，資料集建立好了。

cues.en: And now we're gonna do the same for classification.
cues.zh: 分類也做相同處理。

cues.en: We're gonna click again import data.
cues.zh: 再次 Import data。

cues.en: We're gonna choose tabular again because we have another CSV file for our classification data.
cues.zh: 再次 Tabular，因為分類也是 CSV。

cues.en: Then here, same, we're gonna call it classification data set, okay?
cues.zh: 同樣命名 Classification dataset。

cues.en: And then we click create, alright?
cues.zh: 按 Create。

cues.en: Once again, we're gonna select the file from our computer.
cues.zh: 再次從電腦選檔。

cues.en: Then we're gonna select here the classification_data.csv.
cues.zh: 選 classification_data.csv。

cues.en: We click open, it is importing, well imported.
cues.zh: 按 Open，正在匯入，完成。

cues.en: We click preview data set so that I can explain to you what this is about.
cues.zh: 按 Preview dataset，說明內容。

cues.en: And this time we have a data set containing the health records of different patients taken from different hospitals, each one having a breast cancer tumor.
cues.zh: 這次是不同醫院病患的健康紀錄，每人有乳房腫瘤。

cues.en: And so in this data set, each row corresponds to a different patient, alright?
cues.zh: 每列是一位不同病患。

cues.en: One row is a patient, and for each patient we have the different columns here giving the sample code number of the patient, the clump thickness, uniformity of cell size,
cues.zh: 每位病患有這些欄位，樣本代碼、腫塊厚度、細胞大小均勻度、

cues.en: uniformity of cell shape, marginal adhesion, single epithelial cell size, bare nuclei, bland chromatin, normal nuclei, then the number of mitosis,
cues.zh: 細胞形狀均勻度、邊緣黏附、單一上皮細胞大小、裸核、染色質、正常核仁，以及有絲分裂數，

cues.en: and finally the class which says for each patient whether the breast cancer tumor is gonna be benign, in which case the class is gonna be two, or malignant, in which case the class
cues.zh: 最後 Class 表示腫瘤是否良性，良性為 2；惡性則是

cues.en: is gonna be four, alright?
And so since the class variable only takes the values two and four, while this is a classification problem, actually a binary classification problem because there are only two classes,
cues.zh: Class 只取 2、4，是分類問題，只有兩類，因此是二元分類。

cues.en: and we will build a classification model that will understand the correlation between all these features here of the patient and whether the patient has a benign
cues.zh: 會建立分類模型，理解病患特徵與腫瘤良性

cues.en: or malignant tumor, alright?
cues.zh: 或惡性之間的關係。

cues.en: That's the challenge here.
cues.zh: 這就是挑戰。

cues.en: And so finally, let's click create data set and we have our regression data set and classification ready.
cues.zh: 最後按 Create dataset，迴歸與分類資料都準備好。

cues.en: And so finally, we are ready to move on to the next step, which will be to build our two models for regression and classification.
cues.zh: 現在可以進下一步，建立兩個模型。

cues.en: And we'll do that, of course, in the next two tutorials.
cues.zh: 當然就在接下來兩堂。

cues.en: I can't wait to see you there.
cues.zh: 迫不及待見到你。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
